sources.title: Reviewer Dune query: HLCN holders, ex-CEX/burn/protocol contracts
Block explorer: Halcyon core contracts, proxy admin, timelock, token roles
sources.excerpt: All 14 core contracts verified. ProxyAdmin owned by TimelockController (minDelay 172800s). Timelock proposer = 5-of-8 Safe. Token has no mint function after genesis; MINTER_ROLE renounced at block 19,402,118.

sources.title: DefiLlama: Halcyon TVL, fees, revenue, lending category
Order-book snapshot, 7 venues, 7-day average
sources.excerpt: Aggregate ±2% depth $820k (7d avg). Largest venue 38% of volume. VW spread 9 bps. Volume/depth ratio 17x, in line with lending-token peers (12-25x).

sources.title: GitHub: halcyon-finance org, 90-day activity
sources.excerpt: 210 commits / 14 contributors in 90d across core, periphery, liquidator-bot, subgraph. Contracts repo tag v2.3.1 matches deployed bytecode (reproducible build script).

sources.title: Snapshot + on-chain Governor: last 12 proposals
sources.excerpt: Binding on-chain Governor since 2025-06, 4-day vote, 2-day timelock, 4% quorum. Average participation 6.2% of circulating. Top 3 voters = 41% of votes cast (two are team-adjacent delegates).

sources.title: Wallet screening report (sanctions, mixers, illicit clusters)
sources.excerpt: Treasury, team, deployer and top-200 holder addresses screened. Indirect exposure 0.03% (via DEX aggregator), below 0.5% tolerance. No direct sanctioned counterparties.

sources.title: Lending category dashboard: share by TVL and fees, 2 quarters
sources.excerpt: Halcyon share of lending TVL 7.5% (Q2: 6.1%). Top 3: 41%, 18%, 9%. Halcyon fee share grew while incentive spend fell 30% QoQ.
